description: This file implements the WebSocket opening handshake processor (RFC 6455), including validation of headers, extension handling, and response generation.

classes.name: Handshaker
classes.description: Handles the WebSocket handshake process, including header validation, extension negotiation, and response creation.

methods.name: compute_accept
methods.description: Calculates the Sec-WebSocket-Accept header value from the client's Sec-WebSocket-Key.

methods.name: Handshaker.__init__
methods.description: Initializes the Handshaker with the request and dispatcher objects.

methods.name: Handshaker._validate_connection_header
methods.description: Validates the Connection header contains the required upgrade token.

methods.name: Handshaker.do_handshake
methods.description: Performs the entire WebSocket handshake, including header validation, extension negotiation, and response sending.

methods.name: Handshaker._get_origin
methods.description: Retrieves the Origin header from the request.

methods.name: Handshaker._set_protocol
methods.description: Sets the requested subprotocols from headers.

methods.name: Handshaker._parse_extensions
methods.description: Parses the WebSocket extensions requested by the client.

methods.name: Handshaker._get_key
methods.description: Retrieves and validates the Sec-WebSocket-Key header.

methods.name: Handshaker._create_stream
methods.description: Creates a Stream object for WebSocket data transfer.

methods.name: Handshaker._create_handshake_response
methods.description: Builds the server's handshake response headers.

methods.name: Handshaker._send_handshake
methods.description: Sends the handshake response to the client.
